name: Suvita (Founders Pledge)
summary: SMS reminders and community ambassadors that raise childhood vaccination, plus SMS reminders for antenatal visits, in Bihar and Maharashtra, India. A re-implementation of Founders Pledge's June 2022 cost-effectiveness analysis, which counts under-5 deaths averted and values them in its units of value (WELLBYs).

rows.label: Under-5 deaths averted
Value of averting an under-5 death (in Founders Pledge units: WELLBY-equivalents)
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Founders Pledge's 2022 moral weight for an under-5 death is 241.3 WELLBY-equivalents (127 doubled income-years at its 1.898 per doubling; its Imagine Worldwide sheet of 2023 uses 244.8). The site values every death averted with one shared figure, so that a life saved counts the same in every model: GiveWell's moral weights, 116.25 units of value (a unit of value is a doubled income for a year), times the weight on a life under Your values. Here that value is written in Founders Pledge's units, 116.25 × Founders Pledge's 1.898, so the steps below can stay as Founders Pledge built them; the step into doubled income-years divides the 1.898 out again, so each death counts 116.25. The evaluator view uses Founders Pledge's 241.3.

rows.label: Weight on the value of a life saved (ours)
rows.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's: the shared value-of-life slider (Your values), which scales GiveWell's value of a death averted. The evaluator view pins it at 1, so Founders Pledge's numbers reproduce.

rows.label: Value of the deaths averted (WELLBYs)
Units of value (WELLBYs) per dollar
GiveDirectly's units of value per dollar (Founders Pledge)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's benchmark from its own GiveDirectly analysis: about $170 per WELLBY.

rows.label: Multiple of GiveDirectly
Doubled income-years per dollar
rows.explainer: charityevals' step. Founders Pledge's 2022 'WELLBYs' are its own unit of value, built from its moral weights (3.7 per healthy year, 1.9 per doubled income-year), not life-satisfaction points measured in surveys, so they are not converted at the WELLBY exchange rate. Divided by Founders Pledge's value of doubling one person's income for a year (1.898), its result is in doubled income-years, GiveWell's units of value, so a death keeps exactly the weight Founders Pledge gives it relative to income.
